result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no clear layout breakage. Findings are limited to a duplicated restaurant card and some low-contrast gray text. The clipped chip and carousel items at the right edge and the partially visible pizza card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll/viewport behavior.

issues.description: The two 'Fastest near you' cards are identical (same image, name 'Green Bowl Poké', and €0.90 delivery fee), which looks like duplicated placeholder or data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and show distinct restaurants, or remove the duplicate entry.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (the 'DELIVER TO' label, the search placeholder, and the delivery fee and time metadata) appears light gray on a white background, which may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the white background.
